name: Pennsylvania
source:
"Hi, I'm Pennsylvania.

I spent my time as a hunting rifle alongside the settlers on American soil... but I was also used as a comrade in arms during the Revolutionary War.

I've got rifling, so I'm good at sniping... and Kentucky is like a little brother to me. Compared to modern guns, my performance might be lacking, but... I know a thing or two about living in the woods.
If there's ever anything I can help you with, please don't hesitate to rely on me. Nice to meet you, Master."
